The Explorers Club is pleased to announce that our grant application portal is once again open to receive submissions.

 
 
 

We are currently accepting applications for the following programs:

The Rising Explorer Grant

The goal of this grant is to foster a new generation of explorers dedicated to advancing the scientific knowledge of our world. 

Average Award: $1,500.

We recommend applying if: You are a high school student, college undergraduate, or independent researcher doing work at an equivalent level.

Rolex Explorers Club Grant

The Rolex Explorers Club Grants sends extraordinary young explorers into the field and promotes the significant role that exploration plays in addressing cutting-edge scientific questions, understanding our environment and the world we live in, and learning more about our history to protect our future.

This program is open to all field science disciplines. In addition to demonstrating a spirit of exploration, candidates must put forward a project or research proposal that has a clear scientific rationale, represents original work, and has the potential for significant impact or new understanding.

Historically, awards have been given in the amount of $10,000.

We recommend applying if: You are a young explorer under the age of 35 conducting fieldwork to address a novel scientific, environmental, or historic question.

The Exploration Fund Grant

This category supports exploration and field research for those who are just beginning their research careers. 

Awards are approximately $2,500 to $5,000.

We recommend applying if: You are a graduate/post-graduate student or an early career scientist conducting fieldwork.

 

The Stephenson Explorers Advancement Program

This category supports exploration and field research for marine exploration and conservation projects. The Philip Stephenson Foundation promotes marine exploration, protection, and conservation projects focused on adding value to people’s lives and the health of the environment. 

Awards will be $10,000.

We recommend applying if:  You are a college undergraduate, graduate student, or an independent explorer conducting fieldwork focused specifically on marine research. (Open to those under 35.)

Fjällräven Field Grant

The Explorers Club and Fjällräven share a common goal of understanding the world we live in by supporting and promoting a sustainable future through exploration and research. Furthermore, Fjällräven’s mission is to enable and inspire more people to spend time in nature by creating products that are of minimal impact to our environment and that will withstand a lifetime of use. 

Awards will be $5,000.

We recommend applying if: You are an explorer enrolled in a University degree program doing scientific fieldwork in conservation, the environment or the natural sciences.

Exodus Exploration Without Boundaries Grant

The Explorers Club and partner Exodus Travels believe that explorers are extraordinary individuals who set themselves apart in the pursuit of knowledge. We also believe that explorers come from all backgrounds and walks of life. Therefore, the goal of this program is to support expeditions that further our understanding of the world through scientific, cultural, and conservation fieldwork, and are led by explorers who may have taken alternative routes to acquire the skills necessary to conduct their research.

Awards will be $4,000.

This grant is open to researchers of all skill levels who are 18 or older.

HOW TO APPLY

All grant categories will require you to submit the following via our online application system:

  • A detailed description of your project with attention to scientific objectives
  • A list of team members, project associates, and collaborators
  • Information on the location of your field work
  • Letters of support
  • A copy of your current student ID (if applicable)
  • A budget outline
  • Information on outreach and media plans (if applicable)
  • An outline of Covid-19 precautions
  • Basic information such as start/end dates and overall objectives
 
CLICK HERE TO APPLY

Deadline for applications is 5:00 PM EST, November 15, 2022.

 

NOTE: All applications must be submitted through the online system. If you have trouble with registration, please email gra...@explorers.org.

Awards for applications submitted for the November 2022 deadline will be announced no sooner than March 2023. 

Unfortunately, The Explorers Club will not be able to consider research proposals for work being conducted in China or by Chinese citizens. The Explorers Club is considered a Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) and we do not comply with the Chinese regulations regarding grant awards by NGOs at this time.
